spanish: pozo; lo cavaron príncipes, lo excavaron nobles del pueblo, con el legislador, con sus bastones. Y desde desierto a Mataná,

findings.issue: «a» adds a destination the tokens do not license: the wilderness noun is absolute, not construct, and the proper name has no directional preposition.
The active participle has no article; «el» marks it as definite.

notes: Well, both qal 3cp + 3fs suffixes, princes, nobles of the people, staffs with 3mp suffix, and from wilderness plus the proper name are licensed.
